title: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Name Present
description: Detect whether the name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer is declared on the package label. This check identifies the entity responsible for the product. The presence of a name is an observation; it does not verify the entity's legal registration or identity.
amendment_status: Amendments 2012–2026 not text-verified. This rule is based solely on the original 2011 text.
applicable_scope: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale, excluding: packages >25kg/25L (Rule 3(a)), industrial/institutional consumers (Rule 3(b)).

detection_method.description: OCR extracts all text from the principal display panel. The system searches for text blocks near qualifier phrases or in label regions typically containing manufacturer information.
secondary_patterns: Company name patterns near address blocks
Text in label regions with manufacturer-type metadata

validation_logic.pass_criteria: At least one text block is identified as a company/entity name in proximity to a qualifier phrase or in a manufacturer-label region.

evaluate.action: Extract all OCR text lines with bounding boxes
Search for qualifier phrases (primary_patterns) in text lines
For each qualifier match, examine adjacent text lines (within spatial proximity on label) for entity name
If entity_candidates is non-empty → DETECTED. If qualifier found but no entity name → UNCERTAIN. If no qualifier found → NOT_DETECTED.

observable_evidence.description: What the software can observe: a text string that appears to be a company or entity name, located near qualifier words ('Manufactured by', 'Packed by', etc.) or in a region of the label associated with manufacturer information.
examples: Text line 'Manufactured by Hindustan Unilever Ltd.' detected
Text line 'Packed by: ABC Foods Pvt. Ltd.' detected
Qualifier 'Marketed by' found but no entity name in adjacent text

status_values.DETECTED: A text string identified as an entity name was found near a qualifier phrase or in a manufacturer-label region.
status_values.NOT_DETECTED: No qualifier phrase found and no entity name identifiable in manufacturer-label regions.
status_values.UNCERTAIN: A qualifier phrase was found but the adjacent entity name text is unclear, partially occluded, or below OCR confidence threshold.
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: Product is exempt under Rule 3 (packages >25kg/25L, industrial/institutional) or Rule 26 (exemptions). Requires manual classification.

cannot_conclude: Whether the named entity is the legal manufacturer, packer, or importer
Whether the entity is registered under Rule 27
Whether the name is the 'actual corporate name' per Rule 10(2)
Whether multiple names on the label create ambiguity about responsibility (see Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation II)
Whether a food product follows PFA/FSSAI provisions instead (see Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation III)
Whether a shorter address registered under Rule 28 is in use
notes: Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation I: If no qualifying words ('manufactured by' or 'packed by') appear, the name is presumed to be the manufacturer's. Absence of qualifiers is not itself a violation.
Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation II: If a brand owner appears as 'marketer', they are held responsible. Prosecution targets the first-listed manufacturer.
Rule 10(1): For packages ≤5 cubic cm, a mark enabling identification is sufficient.
This check is for presence only. The system does not verify the legal status of the named entity.
limitations: Based on original 2011 text only. Amendments may have modified exemption lists or added new entity types.
OCR accuracy on curved, reflective, or partially visible labels may cause false NOT_DETECTED results.
The system cannot distinguish between manufacturer, packer, and importer names when multiple entities are listed.
Product category exemptions (food, cosmetics, drugs) are not automatically applied — the system flags all products equally.
